song_craft: Voice: intimate-address couplets (second person throughout — the whole work is one prayer in five postures). Arc: total offering (v1) → victory cry (v2) → complaint turned doctrine (v3) → assurance dissolving doubt (v4) → confession pleading presence (v5). Bhakti postures, not arguments: vocatives load-bearing every verse (row 7). L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: Much time with You has passed — alas, in this very moment! What has not been done by You for me, for the sake of serving the excellent guru!
Again and again, I — whose body has reached the peerless divine plane — yet I forget You. So by You let there be no more staying away.
